validity.recommendation: Do not treat as an independently-documented pipeline. Verify the discrete 'UBTG-1-Berri' entity and its 249 km / 5-diameter spec against a primary Aramco/GIS source before keeping; likely a GIS-trace segment of the Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah–Berri Master Gas System trunk imported with a generic country-stats citation.
validity.researcher_notes: Provenance is the core problem. The gem.wiki page for this row (and every sibling in the UBTG family: P1899 UBTG-1-Berri 2, P1900 UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916, P1901 UBTG-1km-Juaymah, P1910/P1911 UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56, P1912 Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0) cites ONLY the OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin (2012 p.75 / 2013 p.79 / 2017 p.136). Those ASB pages are country-level production/reserves tables — they do NOT name any 'UBTG-1-Berri' pipeline, so they cannot support this row's existence or its specs. The naming scheme itself ('UBTG-1', 'km0', 'km56', 'AY-1 KP916', node-to-node labels) is characteristic of a GIS shapefile decomposition, not an independently reported project. An independent web search for '"UBTG-1" Berri gas pipeline' returns only gem.wiki pages — no trade press, Aramco release, or contractor page names this line. The underlying corridor is real: 'UBTG' plausibly = Uthmaniyah–Berri Trunk Gas, and Berri Gas Plant (1977) + Uthmaniyah Gas Plant (1981) are documented Master Gas System facilities (Saudipedia, verified). But the DISCRETE entity 'UBTG-1-Berri gas pipeline' at 249 km with diameters '56, 36, 38, 40, 42 in' is uncorroborated. That 5-value diameter list is not a plausible spec for a single 249 km trunk — it is a GIS aggregation artifact. GulfPub PE World Map (the best-covered independent Saudi gas dataset, 20 features) has NO Uthmaniyah/UBTG–Berri trunk at all (its only Berri gas entry is 'Qatif - Berri Pipeline', 32 km, 29 in) — the absence of this 249 km line from the best independent dataset reinforces the flag. Classification and attribution DO check out (it is a gas trunk, not oil/NGL; Owner Saudi Aramco 100% is correct — the entire MGS is wholly Aramco), so this is a provenance/existence concern, not a wrong-tracker or wrong-owner concern.

validity.recommendation: Human de-dup pass across the UBTG family. P1898 vs P1899 (UBTG-1-Berri 2) are almost certainly the same corridor double-counted (249 vs 247 km; IDENTICAL diameter multiset). The UBTG-1 trunk is separately decomposed into km-segments P1910/P1911 (UBTG-1-km0-km56), P1900 (UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916) and P1912 (Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0) — confirm whether P1898 (whole-corridor 249 km) overlaps/double-counts those segment rows before keeping all of them.
validity.researcher_notes: P1898 'UBTG-1-Berri' (len 249.00, dia '56, 36, 38, 40, 42', cap blank) and P1899 'UBTG-1-Berri 2' (len 247.00, dia '56, 36, 38, 40, 42', cap blank) share an IDENTICAL five-value diameter list and lengths 2 km apart — the classic signature of a parallel line whose attributes were copied, or of one digitized corridor imported twice. Separately, the sibling rows decompose the very same UBTG-1 trunk into kilometer-post segments: P1912 Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0 (56 km), P1910 + P1911 UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 (both 56 km, the '2' being a parallel), P1900 UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916 (244 km). A 249 km 'UBTG-1-Berri' whole-corridor row plus a full set of km-segment rows for the same UBTG-1 line is very likely a length double-count. All carry the same generic OPEC-ASB citation and 2022-07-19 update stamp, consistent with a single bulk GIS import. Recommend a human decides which one entity (or parallel pair) survives and folds the alternates into OtherEnglishNames rather than keeping ~7 rows for one trunk system.

fills.researcher_notes: Owner Saudi Aramco 100% is well-founded regardless of the row's segmentation problems: the entire Master Gas System (of which any Uthmaniyah/UBTG-Berri trunk is part) is wholly owned and operated by Saudi Aramco, and Saudipedia confirms Aramco operates Berri Gas Plant. Single-publisher (Saudipedia) hence medium, not high. Capacity left blank/UNRESOLVED — no reliable independent figure exists for this specific segment (and its very existence as a discrete entity is in doubt), so no number was forced. Length (249 km) and Diameter ('56, 36, 38, 40, 42 in') deliberately NOT ref-filled: both are uncorroborated GIS-artifact values flagged under the existence concern.

routes.start_name: Uthmaniyah Gas Plant (Ghawar), origin of the UBTG-1 Master Gas System trunk
routes.end_name: Berri Gas Plant, al-Jubail Industrial City, Eastern Province
routes.corridor_desc: If this row represents the real underlying line, the corridor is the Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah gas-plant area in the Ghawar field (central Eastern Province) running roughly north-northeast ~210 km straight-line (~249 km routed, consistent with the sheet length) to Berri Gas Plant on the Gulf coast at al-Jubail. This is one of the original Master Gas System sales/raw-gas trunk corridors. Bound is LOOSE: endpoints are named, real MGS facilities with defensible approximate coordinates, but the exact routing of this specific GIS segment is not independently published and the entity itself is a likely duplicate (see validity). Start coordinate is an approximate placement for the Uthmaniyah plant within Ghawar (~100 km west of Dhahran); end coordinate is the documented Berri Gas Plant location at al-Jubail.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints inferred from the pipeline name ('UBTG' = Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) and the 249 km length, which matches the Uthmaniyah-to-Berri distance. Berri Gas Plant location (al-Jubail, ~26.96N 49.59E) is corroborated by Saudipedia and multiple mapping sources; Uthmaniyah plant location is approximate within the Ghawar/Uthmaniyah area (~25.1N 49.3E, ~100 km west of Dhahran) — NOT a precise sourced coordinate, hence flagged approximate. No coordinates were fabricated: both points are defensible from named, documented facilities. Suggestion only for a later human routes-repo branch; do NOT auto-apply, and note the row may be merged/removed under the duplicate concern before any route work.

summary: P1898 UBTG-1-Berri: CONCERN (existence + duplicate) — GIS-segment artifact of the Uthmaniyah-Berri MGS trunk, sole citation is generic OPEC country stats, absent from GulfPub, and near-identical to P1899 plus overlapping the UBTG-1 km-segment rows; owner=Aramco confirmed, classification (gas trunk) fine; suggested route Uthmaniyah->Berri corridor at low accuracy.
